> What if a methuselah has been life booned 2 times by two different
> methuselahs ? does he offers 1 vp to each one when ousting his first prey ?
> (thus artificially creating a VP from nowhere) or is the 1 VP for the first
> booning meth , then once he kills his other prey, 1 VP to the second booning

Life Boon - Master: Out-of-Turn
* If a player is saved more than once by Life Boon, the various Boons
reserve a series of victory points (and ante), rather than competing with
each other for a single victory point and ante. [RTR 19951017]

> What happens if i life boon my prey and grandprey, then kills everyone
> except me with an Ancillae emp,
> do i get 1 VP for ousting my prey, 1 VP because my prey's prey is ousted,
> then 1 VP for my prey's pre'ys prey, and 1 for last man standing ?

Yes.
You get a VP for your prey.
You get the VP your prey gets for her prey (your grandprey)
You get the VP your grandprey gets for her prey (your great-grandprey).
You get a VP for last man standing.

1.6.1.6: Sequencing: If two or more players want to play a card or
effect, the acting Methuselah plays first. At every stage, the acting
player always has the opportunity to play the next card or effect. So
after playing one effect, she may play another and another. Once she is
finished, the opportunity passes to the defending Methuselah (in the
cases of directed actions and combat), then to the rest of the
Methuselahs in clockwise order from the acting Methuselah. Note that if
any card or effect is used by any Methuselah, the acting Methuselah
again gets the opportunity to play the next effect.

So if a bleed against prey A is declared, Meth A deflects to B, B is
ousted. Player A gets to play life boon first correct? Since they are
to the right of the original Meth. As soon as the deflection is played,
the deflection's target Meth becomes the new "defending Methuselah",
right?

Just to be clear.
